epss.meaning: EPSS is a 0-1 estimate of exploitation in the wild in the next 30 days following score publication.

kev.meaning: Catalog membership is authoritative evidence that exploitation in the wild is known.

refresh_policy.network: Explicit threat-enrich --refresh only; quantify and report paths never refresh implicitly.
refresh_policy.basis: Both sources are living threat datasets and EPSS publishes daily. Forty-eight hours tolerates one missed daily refresh while clearly marking older evidence stale.
refresh_policy.write: Validate required fields and numeric ranges in both responses, then atomically replace the repo-bound mode-0600 cache.
refresh_policy.failure: Any network, HTTP, JSON, schema, range, or identity failure aborts refresh and preserves the prior cache.

offline_policy.current: Display dated evidence when cache age is at most 48 hours.
offline_policy.stale: Display evidence with an explicit stale label; never refresh implicitly.
offline_policy.missing: Display no-cached-enrichment and preserve the industry baseline.
offline_policy.invalid: Reject cache contents and preserve the industry baseline.

quantitative_boundary: EPSS and KEV are informational finding-level threat labels only. They do not alter validity, technical severity, conditional frequency, magnitude, or deal-risk weight while the separate organization-frequency methodology defect remains unresolved.
